name: Agent Skills
what_it_is: A collection of 24 modular software engineering workflow prompts and processes for AI agents.
mentions: Created by former Google AI engineering director Addy Osmani to enforce structured planning, testing, and coding standards.

name: AI Engineering From Scratch
what_it_is: An open-source, comprehensive 20-phase curriculum and repository covering full-stack AI engineering from first principles.
mentions: Featured as a comprehensive 435-lesson viral open-source guide for learning end-to-end AI engineering and multi-agent development.

name: Amazon CloudFront
what_it_is: A global content delivery network (CDN) service.
mentions: Used to cache and serve media files globally from edge locations.

name: Amazon Cognito
what_it_is: An identity management service for user authentication and authorization.
mentions: Used to handle user signup, login, and JWT token authentication.

name: Amazon DynamoDB
what_it_is: A fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database service.
mentions: Used as the persistent data store for the serverless backend.

name: Amazon S3
what_it_is: An object storage service built to store and retrieve any amount of data.
mentions: Used to store user-uploaded files, images, and videos.

name: Amazon SQS
what_it_is: A fully managed message queuing service.
mentions: Used to decouple slow background tasks from synchronous user requests.

name: ApiVault
what_it_is: A curated directory cataloging free public APIs categorized by domain.
mentions: Presented as a completely free resource to discover public APIs across numerous categories for coding projects.

name: AtCoder
what_it_is: A competitive programming platform featuring granular problem difficulty scores.
mentions: Recommended for randomized, untagged practice near the boundary of solvable difficulty.

name: AWS Lambda
what_it_is: A serverless compute service that runs code in response to events.
mentions: Used to execute backend logic for serverless APIs and background job processing.

name: Blender
what_it_is: An open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset.
mentions: Used in conjunction with Claude to automate the generation of 3D models.

name: Claude
what_it_is: An AI assistant and LLM family developed by Anthropic.
mentions: Used to generate 3D models with Blender and automatically import them into Roblox.
Recommended as the AI model to ingest the legal templates and generate customized legal contracts.

name: Claude Code
what_it_is: An agentic command-line interface tool for automated coding and project editing.
mentions: The primary platform discussed for vibe coding and hosting plugins.

name: CLI-Anything
what_it_is: An open-source harness that automatically generates command-line interfaces for GUI applications to enable AI agent tool use.
mentions: Highlighted as a tool that converts desktop applications like Blender, OBS, and Obsidian into CLIs so Claude can control them directly.

name: Cloudflare Computer
what_it_is: A virtual filesystem and execution environment for AI agents that maintains authoritative state in SQLite.
mentions: It gives AI agents persistent file memory across sessions and minimizes the need to spin up Linux containers for basic file operations.

name: CSES Problem Set
what_it_is: A curated collection of algorithmic competitive programming problems maintained by the University of Helsinki.
mentions: Recommended for practicing short, standardized dynamic programming and graph problems before tackling advanced topics.

name: Devmaxx
what_it_is: A mobile learning application designed for daily system design practice and interview preparation.
mentions: Pitched by the creator as a tool to learn and practice system design concepts every day.
Mentioned as a platform to study consistent hashing and other system design concepts through interactive practice questions.

name: e2e
what_it_is: An open-source end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile applications powered by AI agents.
mentions: Presented as an alternative to brittle scripted end-to-end tests by using plain-English goals and cached replay paths.

name: Figma
what_it_is: A collaborative web-based interface design tool.
mentions: Used to design the game UI and tag layer names with animation triggers before exporting.

name: Framewisp
what_it_is: A plugin for converting Figma UI layouts into Roblox Studio UI components and scripts.
mentions: Converts Figma layer tags directly into animated Roblox UI components without manual Luau scripting.

name: GitHub
what_it_is: A developer platform for version control and code hosting.
mentions: Recommended for providing version control over the agent's file system.
Used to host the open-source legal templates repository under a CC0 license.

name: Go
what_it_is: An open-source programming language developed by Google.
mentions: Mentioned because its standard network library enables TCP_NODELAY by default.

name: Graphify
what_it_is: A code analysis tool that builds a queryable knowledge graph out of an existing codebase.
mentions: Prevents AI agents from burning tokens repeatedly rereading repository files.

name: LeetCode
what_it_is: A technical interview preparation platform featuring algorithm coding challenges.
mentions: Critiqued for broad difficulty categories and repetitiveness that discourage transferable problem-solving skills.

name: meetily
what_it_is: A privacy-first AI meeting assistant that processes and stores meeting data completely on the local machine.
mentions: Recommended for privacy-sensitive industries needing automated meeting summaries without third-party cloud data exposure.

name: NeetCode
what_it_is: An interview preparation platform with problem roadmaps and video explanations.
mentions: Critiqued as a topic list that fails to build deep recognition skills needed for unseen interview questions.

name: Notion
what_it_is: A connected workspace for note-taking, project management, and task tracking.
mentions: Used to track open tasks for each project across agent sessions.

name: Obsidian
what_it_is: A markdown-based knowledge base and note-taking application.
mentions: Recommended as the visual interface for viewing and managing the agent folder hierarchy.

name: Omni Route
what_it_is: An AI routing plugin that connects coding agents to hundreds of alternative free and low-cost model providers.
mentions: Enables near-unlimited coding sessions by auto-switching models when rate limits are exceeded.

name: page-agent
what_it_is: An in-page AI GUI agent created by Alibaba that controls web interfaces via natural language.
mentions: Showcased for enabling natural language UI control across onboarding, form filling, and support flows with a single script tag.

name: Ponytail
what_it_is: An optimization plugin designed to compress output and reduce token usage for coding agents.
mentions: Claimed to cut Claude Code token usage by over 50% without sacrificing accuracy.

name: Roblox
what_it_is: An online game platform and game creation system that allows users to program games and play games created by others.
mentions: The video provides five pre-launch guidelines specifically for developers publishing games on the Roblox platform.

name: Roblox Open Cloud API
what_it_is: A set of REST APIs allowing external services to interact with Roblox resources and assets.
mentions: Enables Claude to programmatically upload and configure assets within a Roblox game.

name: Roblox Studio
what_it_is: The development environment for creating Roblox experiences.
mentions: Serves as the target game engine where the generated UI code and animations are imported.

name: Strix
what_it_is: An open-source AI penetration testing agent that identifies and fixes application security vulnerabilities.
mentions: Highlighted as an AI agent capable of running overnight security audits that usually cost thousands of dollars.

name: USACO Guide
what_it_is: A free educational website offering structured tutorials and practice problems for competitive programming.
mentions: Recommended for building a strong foundation in core algorithms and learning the reasoning behind each technique.
Highlighted as a comprehensive, well-structured resource for learning DSA and coding interview topics.
